summary: This sheet is a compact handoff + risk scoreboard for the upcoming renewal season. Probability scores blend quantitative signals (usage trend, support ticket velocity, latency incidents) with qualitative signals (exec sponsorship, legal readiness). Health Score is normalized 0-100 and the Renewal Probability is our current CS-modeled estimate used for forecasting. Use this doc for weekly CS standups and as the primary tracker for half-step escalation play activation.
methodology: Probability = baseline (contract age & ARR weighting) * health modifier (usage delta, incident rate) + qualitative uplift (exec sponsor + legal readiness). Baseline uses ARR bands: <25k=0.25, 25-100k=0.5, 100-250k=0.7, >250k=0.85. Health modifier ranges -0.3 to +0.3. Exec sponsor adds +0.1 if present; legal readiness +0.08 if signed off.
assumptions: Dates reflect current contract term; ARR is ARR recognized for Redwood billing; health scores pulled from Health API snapshot 2026-05-02. Probabilities are forward-looking and assume no major product regressions or pricing changes. Legal turnaround assumed avg 3 weeks for enterprise addendum.
actions: Weekly sync: CS owners update Last Touch and Next Action by EOD Monday
Escalation trigger: probability drop >20pt or health score <40 -> open exec escalation thread
Discount guardrails: only approve up to 10% list for ARR <50k without manager signoff
Deploy winback playbook (v2) for accounts with probability <30% and ARR >25k
Compile QBR one-pager for accounts with >70% probability to accelerate legal signoff
